gkeYamlConfigs:
apiVersion: leaderworkerset.x-k8s.io/v1
kind: LeaderWorkerSet
metadata:
  name: vllm
spec:
  replicas: 1
  leaderWorkerTemplate:
    size: 2
    restartPolicy: RecreateGroupOnPodRestart
    leaderTemplate:
      metadata:
        labels:
          role: leader
          ai.gke.io/model: deepseek-ai.DeepSeek-R1
          ai.gke.io/inference-server: vllm
          examples.ai.gke.io/source: model-garden
      spec:
        nodeSelector:
          cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-h100-80gb
        containers:
          - name: vllm-leader
            image: us-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/vertex-vision-model-garden-dockers/pytorch-vllm-serve:20250304_0916_RC01
            env:
              - name: MODEL_ID
                value: 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1'
              - name: DEPLOY_SOURCE
                value: 'UI_NATIVE_MODEL'
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
              - "/vllm-workspace/ray_init.sh leader --ray_cluster_size=$(LWS_GROUP_SIZE);
                python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --port 8080 --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --pipeline-parallel-size 2 --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096"
            resources:
              limits:
                nvidia.com/gpu: "8"
            ports:
              - containerPort: 8080
            readinessProbe:
              tcpSocket:
                port: 8080
              initialDelaySeconds: 15
              periodSeconds: 10
            volumeMounts:
              - mountPath: /dev/shm
                name: dshm
        volumes:
        - name: dshm
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
    workerTemplate:
      spec:
        nodeSelector:
          cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-h100-80gb
        containers:
          - name: vllm-worker
            image: us-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/vertex-vision-model-garden-dockers/pytorch-vllm-serve:20250304_0916_RC01
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
              - "/vllm-workspace/ray_init.sh worker --ray_address=$(LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS)"
            resources:
              limits:
                nvidia.com/gpu: "8"
            env:
              - name: MODEL_ID
                value: 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1'
              - name: DEPLOY_SOURCE
                value: 'UI_NATIVE_MODEL'
            volumeMounts:
              - mountPath: /dev/shm
                name: dshm
        volumes:
        - name: dshm
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vllm-leader
spec:
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      protocol: TCP
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    leaderworkerset.sigs.k8s.io/name: vllm
    role: leader
  type: ClusterIP

      - name: inference-server
        image: us-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/vertex-vision-model-garden-dockers/pytorch-vllm-serve:20250417_0916_RC01

        - --max-model-len=131072
        - --gpu-memory-utilization=0.95

        - name: DEPLOY_SOURCE
          value: 'UI_NATIVE_MODEL'
        - name: HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: hf-secret
              key: hf_api_token
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: dshm
      volumes:
      - name: dshm
        emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
      nodeSelector:
        cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-h200-141gb

        examples.ai.gke.io/source: model-garden

          requests:
            cpu: 34
            memory: 135Gi
            ephemeral-storage: 150Gi

            cpu: 34
            memory: 135Gi
            ephemeral-storage: 150Gi
            nvidia.com/gpu : 4

        - python
        - -m
        - vllm.entrypoints.api_server
        - --host=0.0.0.0
        - --port=8080

gkeYamlConfigs:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gemma-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gemma-server
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gemma-server
        ai.gke.io/model: gemma-3-4b-pt
        ai.gke.io/inference-server: vllm
        examples.ai.gke.io/source: model-garden
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: inference-server
        image: us-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/vertex-vision-model-garden-dockers/pytorch-vllm-serve:20250312_0916_RC01
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 17
            memory: 68Gi
            ephemeral-storage: 120Gi
            nvidia.com/gpu : 2
          limits:
            cpu: 17
            memory: 68Gi
            ephemeral-storage: 120Gi
            nvidia.com/gpu : 2
        args:
        - python
        - -m
        - vllm.entrypoints.api_server
        - --host=0.0.0.0
        - --port=8080
        - --model=google/gemma-3-4b-pt
        - --tensor-parallel-size=2
        - --swap-space=16
        - --gpu-memory-utilization=0.95
        - --limit_mm_per_prompt='image=5'
        - --max-model-len=32768
        - --max-num-seqs=4
        - --disable-log-stats
        env:
        - name: MODEL_ID
          value: 'google/gemma-3-4b-pt'
        - name: DEPLOY_SOURCE
          value: 'UI_NATIVE_MODEL'
        - name: HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: hf-secret
              key: hf_api_token
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: dshm
      volumes:
      - name: dshm
        emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
      nodeSelector:
        cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-l4
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gemma-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: gemma-server
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 8000
    targetPort: 8080
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: hf-secret
type: Opaque
stringData:
  hf_api_token: {{HF_TOKEN}}

spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gpt-oss-120b-vllm-inference-server
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        ai.gke.io/inference-server: vllm
        ai.gke.io/model: gpt-oss-120b

        examples.ai.gke.io/source: blueprints
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - --model=$(MODEL_ID)
        - --disable-log-requests
        - --gpu-memory-utilization=0.90
        - --max-model-len=2048
        - --tensor-parallel-size=2
        - --max-num-batched-tokens=1024
        - --max-num-seqs=512
        command:
        - python3
        - -m
        - vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server
        env:
        - name: MODEL_ID
          value: openai/gpt-oss-120b
        - name: HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              key: hf_api_token
              name: hf-secret
        - name: HF_HOME
          value: /dev/shm
        - name: PATH
          value: /usr/local/nvidia/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
        - name: LD_LIBRARY_PATH
          value: /usr/local/nvidia/lib:/usr/local/nvidia/lib64
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:gptoss
        name: inference-server
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: metrics
        readinessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 600
          httpGet:
            path: /health

            nvidia.com/gpu: 2

            nvidia.com/gpu: 2

        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: dshm
      nodeSelector:
        cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-h100-80gb
      volumes:
      - emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
        name: dshm

  labels:
    app: gpt-oss-120b-vllm-inference-server
